notes: Joins domestic demand momentum (application share by ASCED broad field) against international-register supply momentum (CRICOS net course change) to map fields as Open / Hot / Crowded / Fading, with an ACU-portfolio overlay. Demand and supply are different markets (domestic vs international register) — read directionally. CRICOS all-levels supply is VET-dominated; the higher-ed cut is the university lens. Employer demand tab (added 2026-11-17): degree-level occupations mapped to ASCED narrow (4-digit) fields via a curated crosswalk (scripts/anzsco_asced_crosswalk.csv), showing projected employment growth and the share of each field's mapped employment in 2026 shortage, coloured by CRICOS higher-ed supply direction. The crosswalk is judgement, not measured graduate flows; no ACU overlay at 4-digit.
